highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships Skia m151, broad managed performance improvements, and WASM support for .NET 11.
highlights_body: This release ports several hot-path operations to managed C# to eliminate P/Invoke round-trips, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for the upcoming .NET 11 WASM runtime, and brings in upstream Skia m151 engine bug fixes.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, picking up upstream bug fixes and GPU stability improvements.
Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes are cherry-picked into the release line, including a CPU raster regression fix for SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse and TryParse now accept ReadOnlySpan<char>, avoiding string allocations in hot paths that parse color strings.

bullets.lead: Performance: hot-path operations ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKFourByteTag.Parse, SKShaper glyph reads via zero-copy spans, and HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 are now managed implementations, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these frequently-called paths.
The unnecessary unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions has been removed, making the type easier to use in safe contexts.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData with crop rect
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) leaked a native resource when the crop rect was provided. The handle is now correctly released.

New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception-handling model are included for .NET 11 WASM targets. A preview-.NET WASM test job is also added to catch exception-handling regressions early.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Performance improvements: SKColor/SKPMColor conversions and SKShaper glyph span reads ported to managed C#

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 merged the final upstream m151 bug-fix syncs, the WASM .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries, and the CPU raster regression fix. This was the final pre-release before stable 4.151.0.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the managed performance improvements across SKColor, SKPMColor, SKFourByteTag, SKShaper, and HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer, plus the SKColor hex-parsing ReadOnlySpan overloads.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated Skia to milestone m151 and laid the foundation for the WASM .NET 11 emscripten work.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free using pooled UTF-8 encoding, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse eliminates the per-call char[4] allocation.
